definition: denoting a past time that was idyllically happy, peaceful, and calm
hook: When you call a time halcyon, you are naming a grieving bird that calmed the sea.
modernAnchor: Halcyon days means the good old days to us. Golden, peaceful, and gone.
journey: In Greek myth, Alcyone lost her husband to a shipwreck and threw herself into the sea in grief.
The gods pitied them and turned the pair into kingfishers, alkyon, birds that nest beside the water.
Her father was Aeolus, keeper of the winds, and each winter he stilled the storms so she could nest.
Those windless days on a flat, quiet sea became known as the halcyon days.
